training: none: load the 150 frozen A1 epoch checkpoints and evaluate fit/validation roles only
source_reconstruction: Use raw final NEZ logits. Confirm sigmoid(logits) matches the model's score_nez within 1e-7. Rebuild C0 VLOO and compare every fold and mean to the published A1 result before C1/C2 analysis.

coordinates.C0_RAW: raw NEZ-positive final logit, then sigmoid
coordinates.C1_CENTERED: subtract median of valid patient logits, then sigmoid
coordinates.C2_ROBUSTZ: subtract median and divide by max(1.4826 * median absolute deviation, 1e-6), then sigmoid

selection.primary: VLOO: 12 patients select epoch and threshold, excluded 13th scores
selection.thresholds: float32 linspace(0.05,0.95,19) on NEZ probability for all three coordinates
tie_break: earlier grid order if residual tie
selection.fullval: same selection on all 13, apparent result reported separately

oracle_diagnostic: For each excluded patient at its VLOO-selected epoch, use that patient's labels to select its own threshold from the same grid. Diagnostic only: never use for candidate selection, gate or outer test.
candidate_selection: C1 replaces primary C2 iff C1 VLOO Macro-F1 >= C2 + 0.005. Retain no normalized candidate unless gain over C0 >=0.010, at least 4/5 positive folds, and mean EZ-F1 nondecreasing.

strong_gate.no_score_pathology: all source/transformed logits and probabilities finite; every valid patient-epoch has MAD > 0 and positive finite robust scale; probability saturation is allowed only if the ranking invariance audit still passes

outer_policy: Validation-only. No current outer-test label, prediction, metric or result may be read. Even if the gate passes, freeze selected coordinate/checkpoint/threshold but do not evaluate outer without a new explicit authorization.
public_data_policy: Aggregate-only code/lock/CSV/JSON/Markdown; keep patient IDs, channel names, logits, probabilities, labels, checkpoints, paths and runtime files private.
